note: Call for a consultant to assess education data capacity in Madagascar; it states nothing on whether a national EMIS exists, is being built or runs the census.

facts.fact: INSTAT reports the education ministry's planning directorate collected the 2022-2023 annual school census from schools, entered it in statistical software developed by the ministry's DTIC, and published the national yearbook.

systems.country_label: logiciel d'application statistique développé par la DTIC

facts.fact: Madagascar's authorities launched at a 15-17 July 2024 workshop in Toamasina the digitisation of schools, starting in Atsinanana, covering data collection and a pupil register, with the education ministry planning extension to other regions.

systems.owner: Ministere de l'Education nationale / Unite de Gouvernance Digitale

facts.fact: The article says work to modernise the education administration's information system was begun in 2023, and a 2025 Senate-adopted financing law for the TALIM programme provides for modernising the education management information system.
